title: Late-Finalization Points on a Patient Financial Assistance Program Award Discount
content:
Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, an award discount on a patient invoice carries late-finalization points when the patient responsibility on the invoice was finalized long after the date of service. The points are added to the discount percent of the award's tier, and the resulting award discount percent is applied once, as one percent.

**The span.** Late-finalization points are counted in calendar days from the invoice's date of service to the date its patient responsibility was posted, as the invoice's ledger shows that posting (the latest posting of patient responsibility on the invoice).

## Schedule of points

| Span from date of service to posting of the patient responsibility | Late-finalization points |
|---|---|
| More than 180 calendar days | 5 |
| More than 120 calendar days but not more than 180 | 3 |
| 120 calendar days or fewer | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical invoice, date of service 5 January 2026)

| Patient responsibility posted on | Span | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 5 May 2026 | 120 days | none |
| 6 May 2026 | 121 days | 3 |
| 4 July 2026 | 180 days | 3 |
| 5 July 2026 | 181 days | 5 |

A span of exactly 120 days earns nothing and a span of exactly 180 days earns 3 points, because each band starts only above its lower figure.

**Illustration (hypothetical award).** At a tier whose discount percent is 50, a span of 181 days gives an award discount percent of 55, applied as one percent.
